change.title: Own one-click entry decisions before protected effects
change.summary: Moves production one-click preflight and recovery ownership behind one runtime entry facade, uses immutable facts and pure decisions before recovery or branch-specific effects, recaptures facts after an actual recovery mutation, and keeps healthy reopen independent from cold/recovery pending-cleanup and SSH-stub failure surfaces.

basis: the production command retains only runtime-owned preflight capture, lock-free provider auth, destructive lease acquisition, and typed DTO projection
the sole production runtime entry facade recaptures config facts and purely selects finalize replay, interrupted-Gateway recovery, or route before applying each recovery effect
the affine interrupted-Gateway terminal handoff is consumed only after post-effect facts are recaptured
the coordinator captures immutable Science/config facts and decides healthy versus mutating entry before pending cleanup, SSH prevalidation, or managed-stub capture
healthy reopen succeeds without reading or consuming a malformed cold/recovery pending-cleanup manifest
a mutating route retries exact pending cleanup first and re-enters fact capture only when cleanup actually changed authority
frontend DTOs, visible text, history semantics, exact stop order, Gateway/Science receipts, binding/finalize behavior, and compensation remain unchanged
focused Rust/Python tests, quality metadata validation, documentation governance, exact-SHA source gate, and clean-context review are required for source closure

giant coordinator decomposition, cross-process writer fencing, durable history recovery, read-model/boot sequencing, artifact, installed, live provider or Science, signing, and release behavior remain excluded
